document.abstract: The demand for motion pictures in color which began in the summer of 1929 continues without abatement. It is reported that some of the larger producers would willingly change back to the black and white pictures but say that the demand for color pictures by the public is so insistent that they do not dare to change. The reason for such statements is based on the fact that the cost for color prints is such a great item.
